Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline listing all topics covered in the module — including PreseMaker's hierarchy, courses, modules, topics, file storage, and content ownership — used by learners and instructors to navigate the module's scope at a glance.

Artifacts.Name: The PreseMaker Hierarchy Overview
Artifacts.Description: An introductory reading that explains what PreseMaker is and describes its four-level organisational hierarchy (course, module, topic, generated content), giving learners a conceptual map of how the platform structures e-learning materials.

Artifacts.Name: Understanding Courses and Modules
Artifacts.Description: A reading that defines courses and modules in PreseMaker, explains the parent-child relationship between them, and establishes how these two elements form the foundational structure for all content created in the platform.

Artifacts.Name: Topics and Generated Materials
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains topics as the core instructional unit within PreseMaker modules, covering how topics are created, nested inside modules, and connected to the generated learning materials they produce.

Artifacts.Name: How PreseMaker Stores Files on Your Computer
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how PreseMaker stores all generated files locally on the user's computer, describing the folder structure it creates and what that means for file access and management.

Artifacts.Name: Accessing and Owning Your Work
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains learner and author ownership of content created in PreseMaker, emphasising that all generated files remain fully accessible and owned by the user rather than held on a remote platform.

Artifacts.Name: Accessing and Owning Your Work
Artifacts.Description: A duplicate of the preceding reading on content ownership in PreseMaker, covering the same material about user ownership and local file accessibility — instructors should verify whether this duplication is intentional.
